newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corporate raider Goldsmith in French hospital with cancer.
newsitem.headline: Corporate raider Goldsmith in French hospital with cancer.

text.p: Anglo-French entrepreneur Sir James Goldsmith is critically ill with cancer in a hospital near Paris, a source close to him said Monday.

Goldsmith, 64, first suffered pancreatic cancer in 1985 but its recurrence was kept secret when he led his Referendum Party in the six-week campaign for Britain's general election on May 1, the British newspaper The Times said.

The party, campaigning against further European Union integration, won more than 800,000 votes but failed to win a seat in the election, which resulted in a landslide victory for Tony Blair's Labour Party.

Goldsmith masterminded million-dollar Wall Street deals and made a vast fortune as a corporate raider. He amassed millions by buying into companies and then selling the stock for big profits after takeover speculation boosted prices.
The source, who requested anonymity, refused to say at which hospital Goldsmith was being treated.
